identity.name: Century Village East
identity.notes: Large 55+ active adult gated condominium community with approximately 8,500 units (8,508 per 55places.com), built 1970–1995 by Levy. Resale only. Managed by a master association (CVE Master Management, 3501 West Drive, 954-421-5566, centuryvillageeast.com) overseeing common areas, infrastructure, security, and shared amenities. Individual condominium sub-associations handle building-specific matters. Price range: low $100ks to mid $300ks.

fees.note: Community recreational fee (master association level). Scenario 1 entry-level buy in a low-fee building (mid-1980s to early 1990s construction). Annual: $3,000. Fees vary by sub-association and unit per hoabulletinboard.com; not uniformly published in public sources. Verify directly with CVE Master Management or individual condo boards. Confidence 0.65 — blog/guide, not official HOA publication.

Building-specific association fee for a low-fee building (mid-1980s to early 1990s construction, SIRS completed, adequate reserves). Scenario 1 entry-level buy. Annual: $2,400. Fees vary by sub-association and unit; verify directly. Confidence 0.65 — blog/guide.
HOA dues range: $213–$560/month. Range reflects variation across sub-associations and unit types. Confidence 0.7 — reputable listing site.

Total annual carry (mandatory cost of ownership) for Scenario 1 entry-level buy at $100,000 purchase price. Includes: community recreational fee $3,000/yr + building HOA $2,400/yr + property tax (Broward County ~19.84 mill rate, homestead exemption) + HO-6 walls-in insurance + estimated SB 4-D reserve premium. Excludes mortgage P&I, special assessments, and personal maintenance. Confidence 0.65 — blog/guide with modeled estimates.

Estimated one-time special assessments by building era (SB 4-D structural reserve exposure): 1970-1975 buildings $15,000-$30,000/unit; 1976-1980 $10,000-$20,000/unit; 1981-1985 $5,000-$15,000/unit; 1986-1995 $3,000-$8,000/unit. These are blog estimates, NOT confirmed assessments - verify with the building's association/SIRS.
